license: Apache-2.0; full installed LICENSE retained beside derived source
adaptation: Original isect_tiles kernel copied unchanged; original second pass and stable CUB sort copied unchanged. Separate host count wrapper returns GPU prefix and scalar view. Finish receives previously read host count. Added explicit metadata/index guards. Installed package and historical source remain unmodified.
headers: Build reads original installed bindings.h, helpers.cuh, types.cuh and third_party/glm headers; these files are not edited.
scope: float32, packed=False, C >= 1; all count/fill/sort work on current CUDA stream. Empty input supported. No backward API.
count_safety: n_isects must be the exact read_totals entry from corresponding immutable CountState. Counts outside nonnegative signed-int32 range raise rather than truncate. Rasterizer int32 range retained.
synchronization: read_totals stacks the GPU scalar views and makes exactly one CPU copy per group. No .item or other scalar readback in count/finish. Cross-stream callers join events before read_totals and record tensor lifetimes. Normal allocation, including CUB scratch allocation, remains; no claim of fully asynchronous dynamic allocation.
